title: Autofill
description: Learn how to save and automatically fill addresses, payment information, and other form data to streamline your browsing experience.
content:
Autofill helps you save time by automatically filling in forms with your saved information. You can store addresses, payment details, and other frequently used data to make online shopping and form completion faster and more convenient.

Oasis Feature

Oasis includes autofill functionality built on Firefox core technology. This feature helps streamline your browsing experience by automatically filling forms with your saved information.

What is Autofill?

Autofill is a browser feature that automatically fills in web forms with your previously saved information. This includes addresses, payment details, contact information, and other data you frequently enter online.

How It Works

  • Saves your form data securely
  • Recognizes form fields automatically
  • Offers to fill information when needed
  • Updates saved data when you make changes
  • Works across different websites

Types of Data Saved

  • Shipping and billing addresses
  • Credit card information
  • Contact information
  • Login credentials
  • Form preferences

Setting Up Autofill

Follow these steps to enable and configure autofill for your information:

1

Enable Autofill

Open your browser settings and navigate to the Privacy & Security section. Look for "Forms and Autofill" or "Autofill" options and enable the feature.

2

Add Your Information

Enter your addresses, payment information, and other details you want to save. You can add multiple addresses and payment methods.

3

Set Preferences

Choose which types of information you want to autofill and configure any additional security settings like requiring confirmation for payment data.

4

Test and Refine

Visit websites with forms to test your autofill settings and make adjustments as needed for optimal performance.

Managing Addresses

Adding New Addresses

  • Fill out address forms on websites
  • Save addresses when prompted
  • Add addresses manually in settings
  • Import addresses from other sources
  • Organize addresses with labels

Managing Saved Addresses

  • Edit existing address information
  • Set default addresses for different purposes
  • Delete addresses you no longer need
  • Organize addresses by type (home, work, etc.)
  • Update addresses when you move

Payment Information

Credit Card Autofill

  • Save card numbers securely
  • Store expiration dates
  • Save cardholder names
  • Set default payment methods
  • Require confirmation for payments

Security Features

  • Encrypted storage of payment data
  • Require primary password for access
  • Confirmation prompts for sensitive data
  • Automatic masking of card numbers
  • Secure transmission of payment info

Using Autofill

1

Form Recognition

When you visit a website with forms, autofill will recognize the fields and offer to fill them with your saved information.

2

Selection and Confirmation

Choose which saved information to use, or let autofill automatically select the most appropriate data for the form.

3

Manual Override

You can always manually edit any autofilled information before submitting the form if needed.

Privacy and Security

Data Protection

  • All autofill data is encrypted
  • Information is stored locally on your device
  • No data is shared with websites automatically
  • You control what information is saved
  • Secure transmission when filling forms

Privacy Controls

  • Choose which websites can use autofill
  • Disable autofill for sensitive forms
  • Clear autofill data when needed
  • Set up primary password protection
  • Control sync settings for autofill data

Customization Options

Autofill Preferences

  • Enable/disable specific data types
  • Set default information for forms
  • Configure confirmation prompts
  • Choose when to offer autofill
  • Set up form field mappings

Advanced Settings

  • Customize autofill behavior
  • Set up address formatting
  • Configure payment preferences
  • Manage sync settings
  • Set up backup options

Troubleshooting

Common Issues

  • Autofill not working on certain sites
  • Incorrect information being filled
  • Forms not being recognized
  • Payment information not saving
  • Sync problems across devices

Solutions

  • Check autofill settings and permissions
  • Update saved information
  • Clear browser cache and cookies
  • Verify form field compatibility
  • Check sync and backup settings

Best Practices

Security Tips

  • Use a primary password to protect autofill data
  • Regularly review and update saved information
  • Be cautious with payment information on public computers
  • Disable autofill for sensitive or financial forms when needed
  • Keep your browser and autofill data updated

Efficiency Tips

  • Organize addresses with clear labels
  • Set default payment methods for different types of purchases
  • Regularly clean up outdated information
  • Use consistent formatting for addresses
  • Test autofill on frequently visited sites

What to Expect

When using autofill, you may experience:

Convenience Benefits

  • Faster form completion
  • Reduced typing and errors
  • Consistent information across sites
  • Streamlined checkout process
  • Time savings on repetitive tasks

Considerations

  • May need to update information periodically
  • Some sites may not support autofill
  • Requires initial setup and configuration
  • May need to adjust preferences over time
  • Should be used carefully on shared devices

Getting Help

For detailed instructions on setting up and managing autofill for addresses and payment information, visit Mozilla's official support guide:

Mozilla Autofill Guide

Technical Details

Autofill functionality uses advanced form recognition and secure data storage:

How Autofill Works

  • Form Recognition: Analyzes form fields to identify what type of information is requested
  • Data Mapping: Matches form fields with your saved information
  • Secure Storage: Encrypts and stores your data locally on your device
  • Smart Suggestions: Offers the most appropriate saved information for each form
  • Privacy Protection: Ensures your data is only used when you approve

Since Oasis is built on Firefox core technology, autofill functionality provides the same reliable form-filling capabilities with enhanced privacy and security features.
